title: USACE inland waterway route check
description: Exactly one dataset item per run: official USACE NTNI notices whose published geometry intersects the route corridor, USACE locks on the route with LPMS-reported conditions, a route-ordered constraints array, notices without published geometry (unverifiedLocationNotices), and per-source coverage. Zero matches means no matching constraints were found in the official datasets successfully checked; it is not a passage, safety or clearance determination. Not navigational advice.

result.title: Waterway route check record
result.description: The single record: status, coverage (ntni, ntniGeometry, corpsLocks, lpms, completeForRequestedSources, sourceFailures, coverageNote), summary, constraints, locks, notices, unverifiedLocationNotices and billing.
